segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Older man —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: anh] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Older woman —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chị] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Younger person —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: em] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Ten, as a group —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chục] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Hundred —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: trăm] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Thousand —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ngàn] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Em đói không?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, có. Đói quá!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Ngon phải không?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, có!] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Today's structure: yes-no questions. Put] [VI: không] [EN: at the end of a sentence to ask yes or no, then answer] [VI: có] [EN: for yes, or] [VI: không] [EN: for no.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: First,] [VI: có] [EN: means yes, or there is. It has] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: — high, rising. Listen again.] [VI_F: có] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: có] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: có] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next,] [VI: đói] [EN: means hungry. It has] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: — high, rising. Listen again.] [VI_F: đói] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: đói] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đói] [EN: Good. Try asking.] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: đói không] [EN: are you hungry?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: There's also a second way to ask, when you expect the answer to be yes. Add] [VI: phải không] [EN: to the end of a statement — it means right, or isn't that so. You already know both pieces.] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: phải không] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: phải không] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: phải không] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.3s] [VI_F: ngon phải không] [EN: it's tasty, right?]

[EN: Quick pass over today's words.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Yes, or there is —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: có] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Hungry —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đói] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Right? —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: phải không] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Let's drill. Yes, or there is —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: có] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Hungry —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đói] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Right? —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: phải không] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now ask. Are you hungry —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Đói không?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Answer yes —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Có.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Answer no —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Không.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now the tag question. It's spicy, right —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Cay phải không?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now reverse. I say the Vietnamese, you say the English.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: có] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: yes, or there is] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: đói] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: hungry] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: phải không] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: right?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: One last time, before we move on.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: có] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: đói] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: phải không] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Remember,] [VI: có] [EN: and] [VI: đói] [EN: both have] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: .]

[EN: Listen again — now you understand it.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Em đói không?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, có. Đói quá!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Ngon phải không?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, có!] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Your turn. Say yes, you are hungry.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ, có. Đói quá.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next lesson, you will learn to say you already ate, or not yet. One word to start —] [VI: ăn] [EN: it means to eat. See you then.]
